notFound: Technika (Tesco): Tesco Direct, the only retailer that sold Technika-branded TVs, closed on 2018-07-09; no current (2026) retailer or official site sells new Technika TVs. Treated as discontinued, no current products listed.

Grundig television offers in UK/IE/MX: Grundig's FineArts Vision 8+ London (CQA 8490, 55"/65" QLED) and VOE74 (43/50/55/65) ranges are confirmed on grundig.com and German retailers (expert.de, rotcom.de, kaufland.de) in EUR, but no current UK, Ireland or Mexico retailer listing was found (Currys UK stocks only Grundig kitchen appliances, not TVs). Models listed with empty offers arrays.

Metz blue OLED (MOD9500, MOD9001) and QLED (MQH8001, MQE7600) ranges: confirmed on the official metzblue.com (Germany) site but no UK/IE/MX retail offer found; only the budget MRF6000Z LED series was found at an actual UK retailer (Electric Shop). OLED models listed with empty offers arrays.

Sansui: no primary brand site or authorised UK/Ireland/Mexico retailer found selling new Sansui-branded televisions; listings found (sansuiworld.com, Amazon.com, Flipkart) are India/US-market only. Not included.

Skyworth: no primary UK/Ireland/Mexico retailer found; UK/Mexico listings located were third-party import marketplaces (Ubuy, eBay), not an authorised brand or retailer channel, so not included per primary-source requirement. Panasonic/Skyworth UK co-branded range announced for 2026 but not yet listed for sale.

Telefunken: only the N19 55"/65" soundbar-TV pair could be confirmed via Irish retailers (DID-style independents, electrocity.ie, connollystopline.ie, callaghanselectrical.co.uk); the 2026 Tizen/webOS/Google TV range announced via totalimports.ie launch event could not be resolved to specific model numbers, sizes or prices within the fetch budget.

Finlux: official UK site (finlux-tv.co.uk) lists only 3 named models (MH24F, MU24F, 40E4QTUK) with no prices shown; ScreenMoove's Finlux collection page was empty at read time; broader 32/40/50-inch range mentioned in marketing copy could not be resolved to specific model numbers.

Loewe, Bang & Olufsen: Mexico and Ireland retail offers not found (premium brands with limited/no MX or IE distribution confirmed); US pricing used for Loewe stellar as the only confirmed market pricing found for that series.
Blaupunkt, Logik, Bush, Cello, Hitachi: Ireland and Mexico offers not found; these are UK-only retail brands (Argos/Currys exclusives or UK-manufactured) with no confirmed IE or MX distribution.

onModeWatts / EU energy label data: not found (left null) for the large majority of products in this file. Argos.co.uk and Currys.co.uk block automated page fetches (HTTP 403), which prevented reading their embedded energy-label widgets directly; EPREL (European Product Registry for Energy Labelling) was not queried within the fetch budget. Figures given for Toshiba 43/50/65UF2653DB (33W/43W/67W) were taken from a secondary source citing the retailer's energy-consumption-per-1000h figure, not read directly from the EPREL record.

Exhaustive 100-model-per-brand coverage was not achieved for any brand; most of these brands currently sell well under 100 distinct models in these markets, and retailer site-blocking (Argos, Currys, AO.com, Loewe.tv, Haier/Grundig consumer pages in some cases) limited the number of models that could be confirmed within the ~120-fetch budget for this pass.
